newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable in thin trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Friday on thin demand ahead of the weekend, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,480-85 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but offers were also heard at five rupiah below and above the range.
Crude palm oil was last done at 1,303 rupiah/kg in the North Sumatran city of Medan against 1,270 previously.
"The market was rather quiet in the second session," one trader said. "Buyers are still coming to terms with the increase in olein prices on Thursday."
Palm olein prices rose after key market players decided at an informal meeting on Wednesday night in Jakarta to raise their offer price to 1,500 rupiah.
The move came on the back of a sharp increase in the price of crude palm oil due, in part, to good export prices.
But traders have since been quoting below the 1,500-rupiah level after buyers showed no interest.
Traders said they expected olein prices to trend higher next week as it adjusts higher to crude palm oil prices.
